title: Temporarily raise the search elapsed limit from 10 s to 60 s so team searches stop refusing
outcome: Temporarily raise the search elapsed limit from 10 s to 60 s so team searches stop refusing
acceptance: The default cooperative elapsed limit for one catalog search is 60 s; every other search limit and the one-worker non-blocking isolation are unchanged
docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md states the 60 s value and says it is temporary containment until the note search no longer decodes every note per call
Focused tests covering the search budget pass on the changed tree
disposal_reason: Its temporary 60 s containment ended by design. Its own docs said "temporary containment until note search no longer decodes every note per call", and w-e0934a2db689 (commit e3ca0fc, "Index public work note text for bounded search") delivered that fix and returned the limit to 10 s as its criterion 3 requires. Current master 83093646 has elapsed = 10 s, so this item's criterion 1 can no longer be evaluated as passing on master. Found by Engram::Fable at about 15:20Z, 2026-10-30, when looking for a live post-restart evaluation candidate.
